clues.text: God sent this angel to Nazareth in Galilee, to a virgin pledged in marriage to Joseph.
This angel greeted Mary as highly favored and told her the Lord was with her.
Speaking with Zechariah, this angel said, "I stand in the presence of God."
When Zechariah doubted the good news, this angel said he would be unable to speak until it came true.
Daniel heard a voice from between the banks of the Ulai, telling this one to explain the vision.
While Daniel prayed, this one came to him in swift flight about the time of the evening sacrifice.
This one came to give Daniel understanding and told him that seventy weeks were decreed for his people.
